historical_questions_reconciliation.q1_task_relative_normalization_methods_t: Task-relative z-scoring in Phase 7F, hierarchical job-level baseline in Phase 7G, window-level robust scaling in Phase 7H.
historical_questions_reconciliation.q2_methods_with_near_zero_variance_blowu: Unfloored task-relative division in Phase 7F produced extreme spikes (>1e6) due to near-zero std in short task runs.
historical_questions_reconciliation.q3_scheduler_metadata_features_in_7k: Phase 7K ablated priority, scheduling class, machine ID, preemption history; found no generalizable signal.
historical_questions_reconciliation.q4_features_improved_validation_ranking: No ablated feature improved parent-job-grouped validation ranking under matched seeds.
historical_questions_reconciliation.q5_negative_platt_slope_occurrence: In Phase 7P, negative slope occurred across pooled OOF due to Fold 0 (a=-0.72) and Fold 1 (a=-0.19), whereas Folds 3 and 4 had positive slopes (+0.30, +0.59).
historical_questions_reconciliation.q6_single_parent_job_influence: Fold 0 placed 643 windows of single job 6251414911 (99.1% normal) into test, causing severe slope distortion.
historical_questions_reconciliation.q7_phase7p_brier_vs_constant_prevalence: Phase 7P calibrated Brier (0.125955) equals static prevalence predictor p(1-p)=0.125844. It did not improve individual discrimination.
historical_questions_reconciliation.q8_n2_checkpoints_reproducible: Yes, re-running inference on saved N2 checkpoints reproduces serialized predictions with max diff < 1e-6.

governance_check: Candidate A Test and Phase 6 holdout strictly excluded.
